name: Profit and margin calculator
blurb: Profit, margin and markup on an item
intro: Find your profit on an item, and your margin and markup in percent.

steps.title: Enter your cost price
steps.body: What you paid for the item.

steps.title: Read the result
steps.body: Margin is profit out of the selling price. Markup is profit out of the cost price.

formula: Profit = selling price − cost price. Margin = profit ÷ selling price × 100. Markup = profit ÷ cost price × 100.
